evidence_slice: HM Revenue & Customs' official Maps of Teesside Freeport tax sites page identifies Wilton International as one of the designated Teesside Freeport tax sites. The Designation of Freeport Tax Sites (Teesside Freeport) Regulations 2021 designate the area shown edged and hatched in red on the map entitled 'Wilton International Tax Zone OBC' dated 11 October 2021, with the designation taking effect on 19 November 2021. The GOV.UK page states that designated Freeport tax sites are recognised in law as geographical areas where businesses can benefit from tax reliefs to bring investment, trade and jobs.

field_evidence.statutory_instrument: The Designation of Freeport Tax Sites (Teesside Freeport) Regulations 2021
field_evidence.designation_scope: area shown edged and hatched in red on the official Wilton International map
field_evidence.policy_purpose: tax reliefs supporting investment, trade, jobs and regeneration

binding_method: statutory Freeport tax-site designation tied to an official map-defined legal geographical area; canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
